name: production control-plane topology
probe: public DNS, ingress and workload placement
pass: ferosse.tech terminates on lcode-4c; lcode-cn is used only by the Google OAuth CONNECT relay

name: overseas source locality
probe: submit an overseas video URL with colab-cli selected and trace source bytes
pass: Colab downloads the source URL directly; neither lcode-4c nor lcode-cn stores or forwards the full source video
forbidden: downloads full video then uploads it to Colab

name: download and model warm-up overlap
probe: timeline events from cold Colab execution
pass: source download and Whisper or vision-model warm-up overlap; neither waits for the other to finish before starting
forbidden: download completes before model loading starts

name: streaming audio processing
probe: long-video processing timeline and temporary storage
pass: audio extraction or segmented ASR begins before the complete source video has been materialized when the source supports ranged or streaming reads
forbidden: wait for full video before audio

name: minimal media return
probe: bytes returned from Colab to the control plane
pass: only selected keyframes, clips, transcript and structured results return; the full source video is not returned

name: idempotent source cache and billing
probe: repeat the same normalized URL and media fingerprint after an injected retry
pass: resolution, subtitles and media fingerprint cache hits prevent duplicate source transfer and duplicate model charges

name: warm Colab worker reuse
probe: submit two jobs inside the configured idle window
pass: the second job reuses the warm session and loaded model; idle autostop still closes the session after the bounded window
forbidden: stop session immediately after every call
